output.scope_note: The paper studies Li-ion conduction in a PEO-PAN blend polymer electrolyte with LiPF6 and reports bulk ionic conductivity (σb) per salt concentration in Table 4, so it is in scope.

records.notes: Table 4 is garbled in the PDF text: the five σb values (0.17, 3.96, 5.53, 3.70, 5.95, ×10-7 S cm-1) are listed as a column without row labels; the assignment to O/Li=16 is inferred from the row order (O/Li=0,14,16,18,20) and from the text stating O/Li=16 has the highest ionic conductivity. The unit is ×10-7 S cm-1, so the reported value 5.53 corresponds to 5.53×10-7 S cm-1 and the unit field shows the header unit only. Only the O/Li=16 record is given because the others are weaker matches; the other compositions were not recorded.
